sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (his move loop): a heavy hunched charge, the arms swinging, the LEGS CHANGING OVER (9 frames)
sheets.weapons: HIS ARMS AND FISTS go where the pale figure has them, frame by frame (image 3 shows them in colour): the two massive arms with the wide dark grey shackles on the wrists, raised, swung, slammed or spread as the pale figure holds them; the cream horns and the icy blue crystal mane stay on his head and back. Only him: no dust, no cracks in the ground, no shockwaves, no glow; the icy blue stays on the mane.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: STRIDE: the FAR leg (the darker one) just landed in front (image right), its hoof flat; the NEAR leg (the lighter one) behind (image left), its hoof on the ground pushing off. Frame 2: SUPPORT ON THE FAR LEG: the far leg planted under his hips; the NEAR leg lifted behind him, bent, its hoof off the ground. The two legs TAKE TURNS: in frames 1-3 the FAR leg (the darker one) carries him, in frames 5-7 the NEAR leg (the lighter one) - frames 2 and 6 must look different: a different leg planted, the other one kicked back. Never the same leg in front in every frame (Senna's first run did that, and Talon's: 「走路没有换腿」).
